table.name: Documents
table.purpose: One row per document (e.g. CVs, articles, reviews) that is composed of paragraphs and built from a template. Referenced by Paragraphs and referencing Templates.

col_001.name: document_id
col_001.description: Primary key identifying each document; referenced by Paragraphs.col_002.

col_002.name: template_id
col_002.description: Reference to Templates.col_001, the template the document is based on. Lookup labels were empty, so the template semantics are unknown.

col_003.name: title
col_003.description: Human-readable document title, unique per row (e.g. 'Robbin CV', 'Customer reviews').

table.name: Paragraphs
table.purpose: One row per paragraph extracted from a document; links each paragraph to its parent document and records an associated country. The table is sparsely populated (15 rows) and one column is entirely empty, so some meanings remain uncertain.

col_001.name: paragraph_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the Paragraphs table; unique integer identifier for each paragraph row.

col_002.name: document_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to Documents.col_001, identifying the document the paragraph belongs to (many paragraphs to one document).

col_003.name: country
col_003.description: A country name (e.g. Korea, Brazil, Fiji, Indonesia, Ireland, Somalia, Japan, Jersey). Likely the country associated with or mentioned in the paragraph; the exact semantic (topic, origin, language locale) cannot be determined from the data alone.

table.name: Ref_Template_Types
table.purpose: Lookup table of template types: a short code paired with a display label, referenced by the Templates table to categorize each template (e.g. presentation, book, CV, paper, advertisement).

col_001.name: template_type_code
col_001.description: Short code identifying the template type (AD=Advertisement, BK=Book, CV=CV, PP=Paper, PPT=Presentation). Primary key; referenced by Templates.col_003.

col_002.name: template_type_label
col_002.description: Human-readable label for the template type, one per code.

table.name: Templates
table.purpose: Document templates: each row is a template used to create documents, classified by template type (book, paper, presentation, CV, advertisement). Referenced by Documents, which apparently stores which template each document was created from.

col_001.name: template_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the Templates table; unique integer identifier for each template. Referenced by Documents.col_002, which stores the template a document was created from.

col_003.name: template_type_code
col_003.description: Code for the template's type, referencing Ref_Template_Types: BK=Book, PP=Paper, AD=Advertisement, PPT=Presentation, CV=CV.

col_004.name: created_at
col_004.description: Timestamp per template, all distinct, range 1975-2012. Likely the template's creation date; alternatively could be a last-modified date, but creation is the more common reading given col_005 exists as a second timestamp.

col_005.name: updated_at
col_005.description: Second timestamp per template, all distinct, range 1973-2015. Likely the template's last-modified/updated date; alternatively an expiry or review date. Note its range starts earlier than col_004, so the created/updated pairing is not certain.
